[[Valley Windworks]] }} '''Honey for Combee''' (Japanese: '''VS ミツハニー''' ''VS Combee''), titled '''VS Combee''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 343rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the sixth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''The Meadow and Sweet Honey''' (Japanese: '''花畑と甘い蜜''' ''Flowerbed and Sweet Honey'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Flower Fields and Sweet Honey''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Pearl}} and {{adv|Diamond}} wake up to their beeping of the [[Pokédex]]es, which means that {{adv|Platinum}} must be near them at the front door. Platinum announces that [[Floaroma Town]] is their next destination. As they arrive, they admire the vast field of flowers blooming everywhere. Diamond and his {{p|Munchlax}} sniff something, and run off in that direction, knocking down a tree before they start licking the [[honey]] off of it. Pearl follows, warning Diamond that he is entering private property. Then, a young girl comes up and cries because they destroyed her precious tree that she had taken great care of. She had spread honey on the tree trunk because she wanted the {{p|Combee}} of the flower field to have it. Suddenly a swarm of wild Combee fly up and sting the boys. Fearing that Platinum would make fun of them if she saw this, Pearl sends [[Chatler]] to tell her to stay in the [[Pick a Peck of Colors Flower Shop]]. Diamond and Pearl then joke about [[Poké Ball]]s to cheer the girl up as an apology. The girl laughs, but is reluctant to forgive them. She explains that her father is going to come back soon and meet her at the tree. Then, her father's {{p|Drifloon}} floats in the sky to their direction, tired and worn out from carrying a tattered lab coat. The girl gets worried and says that her father is working at [[Valley Windworks]]. As the girl, Diamond, and Pearl go off to check things out, Platinum finds them and notices the girl crying. After Pearl explains where they were going, Platinum silently admires them for helping someone they just met by chance. As they arrive at Valley Windworks, the girl becomes frightened by the unusually strong gusts of wind that the station converts into electricity. When they realize that the doors are locked, Pearl has [[Chimler]] burn down the lock. Once the door opens, a {{p|Bronzor}} creeps up in front of them. ==Major events== * {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} arrive at [[Floaroma Town]]. * Diamond is attacked by {{p|Combee}} after knocking down a girl's tree. * Diamand, Pearl, and Platinum go to [[Valley Windworks]] to help look for a little girl's father. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Combee}} * {{p|Drifloon}} * {{p|Bronzor}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Valley Windworks]] manager's daughter ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Turtwig}} ([[Tru]]/{{tt|Wig|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Chatot}} ([[Chatler]]/{{tt|Chahiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Chimchar}} ([[Chimler]]/{{tt|Chimhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Ponyta}} ({{OP|Platinum|Ponyta}}) * {{p|Piplup}} ({{OP|Platinum|Piplup}}) * {{p|Bronzor}} ([[Mars]]'s; debut) * {{p|Drifloon}} ([[Valley Windworks]] manager's; debut) * {{p|Combee}} (multiple; debut) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, {{adv|Platinum}} calls the [[Pick a Peck of Colors Flower Shop]] the "Pick a Peck of Flowers Shop." * In the [[VIZ Media]] version, a closing quotation mark is missing when Platinum reads from the travel guide. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 三蜜蜂|VS Combee}} |fr=Le champ de fleurs à l'odeur de miel |de=VS.
